verdict.rationale: Lago's own platform page says its AI agent lets users manage billing by describing what they need in plain language. This is backed by an official MCP server that gives assistants like Claude direct access to billing data, and a Dunning Agent that acts on accounts. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on which billing operations the natural-language agent can perform, and hands-on or independent corroboration that it works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: With our AI agent, you manage billing by describing what you need in plain language. No manual steps, no busywork.
The Lago MCP Server (Model Context Protocol) is written in Rust and provides AI assistants (like Claude) with direct access to Lago's billing data.
